sentences.text: I could not confirm a foreclosure charge for car loans from the provided documents, because the in-force charge clauses shown are in a home loan agreement and its copy, not a car loan document.
Those in-force home loan clauses state a pre-payment charge of 2% of principal outstanding in one version and 3% in the copy, payable on pre-payment or foreclosure.

The RBI foreclosure-charge directions cited here are superseded or no longer in force, and the currently applicable UCB prepayment rules are still unknown for this case because facility, rate type, and sanction date are needed.

I need the car-loan agreement or policy clause for foreclosure charges to answer the car-loan question specifically, because none of the cited in-force documents identifies a car-loan foreclosure fee.

missing.searched: in-force bank documents and cited RBI rule findings for a car loan foreclosure fee
UCB prepayment rule applicability for this case
